ExtraBar 1.3.3 – Copy, Move & Multi-Select Mastery! 📋✨

⚡ Improvements

  • Effortless Cross-App Copy & Move: Moving items between apps is now easy to use — drilling into another app automatically selects it as the destination, and a new status bar always shows exactly where your items will land!
  • More Powerful Multi-Select: Menu multi-select now supports batch Delete, and dividers can be selected for Move and Copy right alongside your actions!

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Live Bar Menu Refresh: Fixed the live bar menu not refreshing after copying or moving items into another app — it now shows the updated menu immediately!
  • Collapsed Menu Click: Fixed the primary click action on collapsed menus so it works exactly as expected!

🏷️ Renamed

  • "Select" Button: The menu multi-select entry button is now called "Select" for extra clarity!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
